description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearCompiledTemplate', implementing the method to clear cached compiled templates in Smarty templating system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearCompiledTemplate
classes.description: A class providing the method to clear compiled Smarty template files, supporting directory traversal and cache invalidation.

methods.name: clearCompiledTemplate
methods.description: Deletes compiled template files in the specified directory, optionally based on resource name, compile ID, and expiration time.
